svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Cantarell, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Clipman architecture
svg.desc: Capture: an app copies to the Wayland clipboard. The Clipman GNOME Shell extension sees the owner-changed signal and sends the text to the daemon's D-Bus service with NewEntry; images are read with wl-paste. The clipboard monitor drops duplicates by SHA-256 hash, checks for secrets, and stores the clip in clipman.db (SQLite, WAL) and images/. Paste: Super+V runs clipman toggle, which calls Toggle on the D-Bus service to show the popup. The popup reads the history, puts the chosen clip on the clipboard with wl-copy, and asks the extension to give focus back and type the paste keys into the app. The daemon runs as a systemd user service; its only network call is an opt-in daily update check to the GitHub Releases API.

g.text: once a day, in a thread

svg.text: lines cross, they do not join
